name: How long does it take to install a custom door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a custom door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom door installation varies based on the door's complexity, material, and any necessary site preparations. Typically, once the custom door is ordered and fabricated, the on-site installation itself can take anywhere from a few hours for a standard replacement to a full day or more for complex entry systems requiring significant frame modifications. For instance, a custom mahogany door with intricate glass inserts will require more fabrication time than a simple custom-sized interior door. We provide a detailed project timeline after the initial consultation and measurements, taking into account any specific requirements for your property in areas like Garden City or Meridian.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, but on-site work usually takes a few hours to a full day, depending on complexity and preparation.
